qr.unavailable: This code is too large for a QR image. Copy the code and paste it on the other device instead.
qr.copied: Copied. Paste it on the other device.
qr.copyFallback: Automatic copying is unavailable. The code is selected below; copy it using your device's copy command.

scanner.title: Read a pairing code
scanner.intro: Scan with your camera, choose a QR image, or paste a code. Everything is read on this device.
scanner.preview: Camera preview for scanning a pairing code
scanner.aim: Keep the full QR code in view. The camera stops after reading it.
scanner.unavailable: Camera scanning is unavailable here. Choose a QR image or paste the code below.
scanner.denied: Camera permission wasn't granted. You can choose a QR image or paste the code instead.
scanner.cameraFailed: The camera couldn't start. Close any other app using it, try again, or paste the code below.
scanner.cameraStopped: The camera stopped. Start it again or use an image or pasted code.
scanner.imageInvalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image smaller than 10 MB.
scanner.imageFailed: This image couldn't be read. Try a different image or paste the code.
scanner.noCode: No QR code was found. Choose a clearer image with the whole code visible, or paste it below.
scanner.paste: Paste a pairing code or link
scanner.invalidCode: Paste a complete pairing code or link from Tipsy Trouble.

room.title: Play on your own phones
room.intro: One device hosts. Everyone sees the same game.
room.hostHint: Choose an existing player for each phone. The host can always advance the game.
room.offerTitle: 1. Open this on the player’s phone
room.offerHint: Scan this QR code or send the link. Their phone will create a reply code.
room.connectedHint: Their phone is connected and receiving this game.
room.answerTitle: Show this reply to the host
room.answerHint: On the host’s device, choose “Read the player’s reply” and scan this code, choose its image, or paste the copied link.
room.waiting: Keep this page open. The shared game appears when the host accepts your reply.
room.hostDescription: Keep the game on this device and connect your friends’ phones.
room.joinDescription: Read the host’s code. Your own saved game stays on this device.
room.network: Use the same Wi-Fi or a nearby hotspot. Pairing runs directly between devices, without a server. Some networks block device connections; you can still play together on the host’s device. Keep both pages open.

guest.disconnected: Connection lost. The last received turn is shown below.
guest.ruleTitle: A new house rule is coming
guest.waitForRule: Waiting for {name} to write a house rule.
guest.waitForTurn: Waiting for {name} or the host to advance.
guest.saving: Waiting for the host to save…
guest.emptyHint: Read the host’s pairing code to join. Your own saved game is unchanged.

errors.artwork: The current card image could not be shared. The game can still continue.
errors.leaveGuest: Leave the shared game before hosting your own.
errors.startGame: Set up a game on this device before connecting players.
errors.player: This player is no longer in the host’s game. Choose a current player.
errors.limit: You can connect up to {count} phones. Disconnect one before adding another.
errors.ended: The host stopped sharing this game. You can leave or connect to a new game.
errors.changedRoom: The shared game changed unexpectedly. Ask the host for a new pairing code.
errors.stopHost: Stop sharing your game before joining another host.
errors.timeout: The host did not confirm this action. Reconnect to check the saved turn before trying again.

rejections.wrong-room: This connection belongs to another game. Ask the host for a new pairing code.
rejections.stale: The game has already moved on. The latest saved turn is shown.
rejections.busy: The host is saving another action. Try again shortly.
rejections.not-your-turn: Only the current player or the host can advance this turn.
rejections.invalid-command: That action cannot be applied to this turn. Check the current card and try again.
rejections.save-failed: The host could not save this action. The turn is unchanged; try again.
